title: Uninsured-Driver Collision Deductible Waiver Decision Table, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Waiver terms.** On a Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage collision claim under a deductible option that carries the uninsured-driver collision deductible waiver, when the latest fault determination finds the other party at fault with no share of fault on the Cardinal driver and the other party identified and uninsured, the deductible is waived entirely; when the latest fault determination charges the Cardinal driver a share of fault above zero and no more than 25 percent and the other party is identified and uninsured, the deductible is charged at 75 percent; in every other case, a hit-and-run with an unidentified driver included, the deductible is charged in full.

The waiver share multiplies the deductible as otherwise determined for the claim, and the product is rounded to the cent only at the end.

**Options carrying the waiver:** Cardinal Physical Damage $750, $500, $250 and $100 Deductible. The $2,000 and $1,000 Deductible options do not carry it.

The fault finding, the Cardinal driver's share of fault and the other party's insurance status are read from the claim's latest fault determination; an identified, uninsured other party is one whose insurance status is recorded as uninsured.

## Decision table

| Coverage part | Option carries the waiver | Latest fault determination | Other party | Share of the deductible charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Collision | Yes | Other party at fault, Cardinal driver's share 0 percent | Identified, uninsured | None (waived) |
| Collision | Yes | Cardinal driver's share above 0 and at most 25 percent | Identified, uninsured | 75 percent |
| Collision | Yes | Cardinal driver's share above 25 percent | Any | Full |
| Collision | Yes | Any | Insured, or an unidentified hit-and-run driver | Full |
| Collision | Yes | No fault determination on the claim | — | Full |
| Collision | No | Any | Any | Full |
| Comprehensive | Either | Any | Any | Full |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Collision claim on the $500 option, other party identified and uninsured, deductible as otherwise determined 500.00:
- Cardinal driver's share 0 percent, other party found at fault: waived, 0.00.
- Share 25 percent: 75 percent of 500.00, that is 375.00.
- Share 26 percent: charged in full, 500.00.

The same facts on the $1,000 option: the option does not carry the waiver, so the deductible is charged in full.
